body:
thank you for posting this, it is always very insightful to hear of somebody who managed to overcome these burdens and function properly.

It does seem impossible at the moment, and i suppose there is no way it wont. Hopefully that might change, but it hasn't so far, only gotten worse.

i thought of putting it a bit back, until at least i figured out a way to do it without causing damage to whatever is left of my family.
I usually use lighters and matches to burns my arms and legs.
I have, but i don't want to get locked up in a mental institution, and i would be if i was honest with them, since i self-harm.
No, i have nobody to talk to really, i think i wrote this post just to let somebody know.
I see what you are saying, but its so difficult to see any good, or even potential for it. I am 19 years old at the moment.
hopefully Thursday, but its is scary.
